IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_malinois: A police and detection dog. Focused on scent, obedience and combat. A dog with a unique mechanic: it doesn't just scent the zombie, it shows you its exact location. Found at police stations, military buildings and, rarely, in houses.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_K9Scent_desc: Your Malinois is the best at scent: it can sniff out the exact position of the nearest zombie.
